title: Bullet Journal Planner Sticker Sheet
author: Creative Art Tribe
description:
♥ I know many of us use the bullet journal method for planning but maybe not enough time for hand drawing.
♥ These stickers will help you with the designing part of the planner or bullet journal.
WHAT IS INCLUDED? 
1 JPEG file with cutline / 1 JPEG without cutline (300dpi)
1 PDF file with cutline / 1 PDF without cutline1 PNG file with cutline /
1 PNG without cutline (300dpi)
1 DXF file with cutline / 1 DXF without cutline1 SVG file with cutline /
1 SVG without cutline1 EPS file with cutline / 1 EPS without cutline
25 png files with individual stickers
-> these files are compressed in 1 ZIP archives
-> After you download these digital files, you can print it out on sticker paper OR normal paper and cut them by hand or use a cutting device such as a Silhouette or Cricut.
PLEASE NOTE:
-> Colors display and print differently depending on monitor and printer settings.
-> Print as often as you like from the comfort of your home.
-> High-quality print resolution for gorgeous sharp stickers.
-> Compatible with many planners or can be size-adjusted with photo editing software.
-> PNG Cutting Template and DXF files that can be used to create cutting files
